name: Auto Join Channels
description: Automatically adds new and existing active users to specific general channels.

settings_schema.footer: Configure the channels that all users must belong to. The plugin will check periodically and when a user is created.

settings.display_name: Auto Join Channels List (IDs or Names):
settings.help_text: Comma-separated list of Channel IDs or Channel Names/Handles (e.g. 'town-square, off-topic, general'). Users will be joined to the corresponding teams and channels automatically.
How often the background worker scans active users to add missing members to the configured channels. Default: 10 minutes.
